review:
Fortune Trio: Minions of Fu is an Asian-inspired 5x3 classic with three bonus games, a three-pot coin collection system and three jackpots.

Three or more yin-yang bonus symbols unlock free spins with either a giant symbol or only high-paying symbols in play, and extra bonus symbols extend the round. Six or more gold coins trigger a coin round in which the pots and collect coins can grow wins further. BGaming rates it medium-low volatility with a 2,000x maximum and a 95.05% RTP. Free spins arrive about once every 206 spins. Lots of variety for a classic-style game.
pros: Lower volatility suits longer, steadier sessions
Second route to big wins via respins or jackpots
Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
